facts.fact: Ministerial order no. 038974 of 6 November 2025 authorised Starlink Sénégal SUARL to operate as an internet access provider for five years, renewable.

facts.fact: Per an Africa CEO Forum and Askya report, Senegal's regulators formally recognised Starlink as an internet service provider in February 2026, after it had entered the market before authorisation; the licence cost about $150,000.
Starlink satellite internet has been officially available in Senegal since February 2026, with monthly subscriptions estimated at CFA22,000 to CFA30,000 excluding equipment.

Starlink obtained a five-year, renewable authorisation to operate in Senegal, as stated by the minister to parliament; grant date not given, article published 2026-02-26.
